alerts.headline: From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Sept. 21, through Friday morning, Sept. 25, two lanes of westbound I-90 will close between 150th Avenue SE and I-405 for construction. Delays are possible passing through the work zone.
Southbound I-405 will fully close from Coal Creek Parkway Southeast to North 30th Street from 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25 to 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 28. A southbound detour will be in place.

From as early as 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Sept. 23, through Friday morning, Sept. 25, two lanes of eastbound I-90 will close between I-405 and 150th Avenue SE for construction. Delays are possible through the work zone.
The 112th Avenue Southeast on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.

From 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Sept. 23, until Friday morning, Sept. 25, the northbound and southbound I-405 ramps to eastbound I-90 will close for construction. Signed detours will guide people around the ramp closures.
The southbound I-405 Lake Washington Boulevard on-/off-ramps will close from 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25 to 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 28.

From 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Sept. 21, until Wednesday morning, Sept. 23, the westbound I-90 ramps to northbound and southbound I-405 will close for construction. Signed detours will guide people around the closures.
The Coal Creek Parkway Southeast on-ramp to southbound I-405 will close from 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25 to 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 28.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Coal Creek Parkway Southeast will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.

The Northeast 10th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight, 9 p.m. Monday, Sept. 21 – 5 a.m. Tuesday, Sept. 22. A signed detour will be in place. The on-ramp to SR 520 will also be closed.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Sept. 21, until Wednesday morning, Sept. 23, the westbound I-90 on-ramp from 148th Avenue SE will close for construction. Signed detours will guide people around the lane closure.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to 112th Avenue Southeast will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Sept. 23, until Friday morning, Sept. 25, the westbound I-90 on-ramp from 142nd Place Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will guide people around the closure.
The Northeast 160th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed Sunday from 3:30 a.m. to 7 a.m.

Daily from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. beginning Monday, Sept. 21 to 2 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 24, the right lane of westbound State Route 18 from State Route 181/West Valley Highway to Peasley Canyon Road (milepost 2) will close for maintenance.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.
From 11:59 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 24 to 4 a.m. Friday, Sept. 25 expect rolling slowdowns on all Interstate 5 ramps between South Boeing Access Road and State Route 516 for utilities work.

From 7 p.m. Monday, Sept. 21, until 4 a.m. Tuesday, Sept. 22, two lanes of northbound SR 167 will close between SR 516 and South 212th Street for crack sealing. Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 7 p.m. Wednesday, Sept. 21, until 4 a.m. Thursday, Sept. 24, two lanes of northbound SR 167 will close between SR 516 and South 212th Street for crack sealing. Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 7 p.m. to 4 a.m. nightly Tuesday, Sept. 22, through Friday morning, Sept. 25, two lanes of southbound SR 167 will close between South 277th Street and South 212th Street for crack sealing. Delays are possible through the work zone.
From 9 p.m. Wednesday, Sept. 23, until 12:01 a.m. Thursday, Sept. 24, the westbound SR 516 on-ramp to northbound SR 167 will close for crack sealing. Signed detours will be available.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 24, to 12:01 a.m. Friday, Sept. 25, the southbound SR 167 on-ramp from 84th Avenue South and Central Avenue will close for crack sealing. Signed detours will be available.
From 3 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 25, the southbound SR 167 off-ramp to South 277th Street will close for crack sealing. Signed detours will guide people around the closure.

From 12:01 to 5 a.m. Thursday, Sept. 24, the northbound SR 167 off-ramp to 84th Avenue South/Central Avenue, and the northbound and southbound SR 167 on ramps from 84th Avenue South/Central Avenue, will close for crack sealing and pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

From 12:01 to 2:30 a.m. Friday, Sept. 25, the southbound SR 167 off-ramp to SR 516, and the SR 516 on-ramp to southbound SR 167, will close for crack sealing and pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.
Saturday, September 19 to the morning of Sunday, September 20: Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed from 8:30 p.m. – 10 a.m.
The Northeast 128th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. Saturday, Sept. 19 to 7 a.m. Sunday, Sept. 20.
The northbound and southbound I-405 on-/off-ramps at Northeast 132nd Street will close from 10 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25 to 5 a.m. Monday, Sept. 28.

Saturday, September 19 to the morning of Sunday, September 20: Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed from 10:30 p.m. – 8 a.m.

Nightly from 9:30 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Tuesday, Sept. 22 to 5 a.m. Thursday, Sept. 24, two right lanes of northbound Interstate 5 from the King/Pierce county line to South 375th Street/South 376th Street (milepost 140) will close for maintenance.

The right lane on northbound and southbound SR 161 will close during the day Sunday through Thursday for about six weeks for ongoing fish passage construction. 

From 6 a.m. to 3 p.m., one lane of southbound SR 161 will close.

From 9 p.m. to 5 p.m., one lane of northbound SR 161 will close.

People traveling through the area during these times should expect delays, particularly during peak travel times.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.
From 9 to 11 a.m. Wednesday, Sept. 23, State Route 202 traffic will alternate with flaggers over the South Fork Snoqualmie River Bridge (milepost 29) for maintenance.

From noon to 3 p.m. Tuesday, Sept. 8 and daily from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. (except Saturday, Sunday) beginning Wednesday, Sept. 9 to 3 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25, the right lane of southbound State Route 515 from the Interstate 405 interchange to South Puget Drive (milepost 6) will close. The sidewalk in this area will also close.
All lanes of northbound I-405 from North Southport Drive to Coal Creek Parkway Southeast will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept 21.
From 8 p.m. Monday, Sept. 28, until 4 a.m. Tuesday, Sept. 29, one lane of northbound SR 167 will close from just south of I-405 to SR 900 for crack sealing. Delays are possible through the work zone.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to North 30th Street will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The North 30th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The southbound I-5 off-ramp to Northeast 30th Street will close from 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25 to 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 28.
Update 2:45 AM : On I-405 southbound at SR 167 (MP 2) there is a collision blocking the HOV lane.  Medical Aid, Fire Assistance, and the State Patrol have arrived on the scene.
The southbound I-405 Northeast 44th Street on-/off-ramps will close from 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25 to 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 28.
The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The North Southport Drive on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The Harvard Avenue on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until mid-October for the Revive I-5 Ship Canal Bridge construction project.
From noon to 1:30 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 24, the right lane of the westbound South Columbian Way ramp from Interstate 5 (milepost 163) will close for maintenance.
The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.
The express lanes will operate northbound-only 24 hours a day until the end of the year, to support  Revive I-5 northbound construction.
From 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. on Monday, Sept. 21 and Tuesday, Sept. 22, State Route 202 traffic will alternate with flaggers over the Snoqualmie River Bridge (milepost 26) for maintenance.
From 10 p.m. Sunday, Sept. 20 to 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21, contractor crews will close the southbound I-5 ramp to southbound I-405 in Lynnwood for striping.

From 10 p.m. Tuesday, Sept. 22 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Sept. 23 four left lanes of northbound Interstate 5 from State Route 526/State Route 527 to 47th Street Southeast (milepost 191) will close for maintenance.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 24 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 25 US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers at Fir Road (milepost 32) will close for utilities work.

Westbound SR 524/196th Street SW has been reduced to one lane and eastbound SR 524/196th Street SW has been reduced to two lanes, 24 hours a day, near the I-5 interchange for a city of Lynnwood construction project.

Update 3:08 AM : On I-5 southbound just south of 172nd St NE (MP 205) there is a collision blocking the left lane and the right lane.  Medical Aid, Fire Assistance, and the State Patrol have arrived on the scene.

From 5:30 to 10:30 a.m. Saturday, Sept. 19, the left lane of northbound Interstate 5 from the State Route 529 Steamboat Slough bridge to the Ebey Slough bridge (milepost 198) will close for maintenance. From 5:30 to 11:30 a.m. Sunday, Sept. 20, the right lane of southbound I-5 from the Ebey Slough bridge to the SR 529 Steamboat Slough bridge will close.
From 10 p.m. Wednesday, Sept. 23 to 5 a.m. Thursday, Sept. 24 two left lanes of southbound Interstate 5 from 148th Street Southwest to Maple Road (milepost 184) will close for maintenance.
From 9 p.m. Tuesday, Sept. 22 to 12:30 a.m. Wednesday, Sept. 23 the right lane of southbound State Route 99 at 148th Street Southwest (milepost 50) will close for utilities work.

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until further notice: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).
From 8 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 to 6 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21, contractor crews will alternate traffic on SR 203 at Riley Slough Bridge (milepost 22) in Monroe for bridge deck repairs.

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.

Daily from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. beginning Monday, Sept. 14 to 2 p.m. Friday, Sept. 25, State Route 96 traffic will alternate with flaggers from East Lowell Larimer Road (milepost 5) to State Route 9/Broadway (milepost 6) for utilities work.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 will be closed from Northeast 128th Street (milepost 21.43) to SR 522 (milepost 24.8) overnight from 11 p.m. Saturday, Sept. 19 to 7 a.m. Sunday, Sept. 20. Crews will implement a rolling slowdown between 12:01 a.m. and 4 a.m.
